description: Submit the complete implementation plan for user review. Use this only in Plan mode and call it by itself. Keep every step concrete and ordered, and give each step a verification method. A successful call ends the planning turn; Runtime assigns the proposal ID and revision and waits for the user to approve, reject, or adjust it.

propertyDescriptions.title: A concise title for the complete implementation proposal.
propertyDescriptions.overview: A self-contained overview of the intended changes, important constraints, and overall approach.
propertyDescriptions.steps: The complete ordered implementation sequence presented for user review.
propertyDescriptions.steps[].title: A concise title for this implementation step.
propertyDescriptions.steps[].description: The concrete work that this step will perform.
propertyDescriptions.steps[].verification: The specific check that will demonstrate this step was completed correctly.

guidance: propose_plan is the only valid way to submit a Plan-mode proposal for user review. Investigate first with read-only tools as needed, then call propose_plan by itself with a concise title, an overview, ordered implementation steps, and a concrete verification statement for every step. Do not put implementation work in the proposal, do not call write tools, and do not return a plain-text plan instead of this tool. Runtime assigns the plan ID and revision, persists it, and ends the turn for user review.
